summary: First iteration end-to-end testing of BitsNdBricks Phase 1 (Jobs+Tenders MVP). Backend: 22/22 pytest tests passed covering meta, public listings, filters, slug/BNB-id lookup, public submission workflow (pending+hidden), file upload+download, admin CRUD, sequential BNB-J/BNB-T ID generation, verify/publish/archive/reject/delete status transitions, and public_view stripping of submitter fields. Frontend: Home, /jobs, /tenders, job/tender detail pages, hero search, /submit form and /admin route all render correctly with seeded data (4 active jobs + 6 tenders + 2 archived jobs). Verified Source badge shows only when verification_status=verified. Apply Now and Official Tender Portal buttons render on detail pages. Admin route accessible without auth as expected (hidden route).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py archived listings can still be fetched via GET /api/jobs/{slug} because the 404 filter only blocks draft/pending/rejected. Consider blocking 'archived' from public detail too, or intentionally allow for stable SEO URLs (document the choice).

compute_expiry uses last_date as-is which may be a plain date string (e.g. '2026-08-18'); comparison against now_iso() (with timezone) still works lexicographically but is fragile. Consider normalising both to ISO 8601 with tz.

public_view strips source_type from list/detail responses, but /jobs listing does not filter out 'archived' status (query is explicit status:active) — good. Just confirmed pending/draft/rejected are also excluded correctly.

Storage init happens on startup; if the integrations service is down the app still starts (good) but /api/upload will fail with unhandled requests.HTTPError -> 500. Consider try/except and return 503.
test_credentials: None required (no auth). Admin at /admin is public.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded data (6 jobs BNB-J-2026-00001..00006, 6 tenders BNB-T-2026-00001..00006). Created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed jobs/tenders during pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all critical flows; auto-cleans TEST_ prefixed docs. Frontend submit form uses shadcn Select for state/city - to test end-to-end via Playwright, click the SelectTrigger then a SelectItem instead of using .fill(). Admin edit modal fields use data-testid admin-field-*.
